notes.title: Early Access Update 5
notes.notes:
[h1]Figure rework:[/h1]
To prepare for the Christmas update featuring legendary prisms, a rework of the hand system has been carried out. The goal is to simplify the number of combinations, reducing them from 14 to 9. The hierarchy of hands has been reorganized according to their difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004874/504db3ad7cef49e248510007492684428779068e.png[/img]

The base points and multipliers for each hand have also been increased for smaller combinations. Full House and Fortune remain unchanged in terms of points, while other hands have been adjusted in relation to them.

[olist]
[*] High_Dice 1M 5P => 2M 20P
[*] Pair 2M 10P => 3M 30P
[*] Double_Pair 2M 20P => 4M 35P
[*] Three_Of_A_Kind 4M 30P => 5M 35P
[*] Full_House 6M 40P
[*] Flush 14M 140P => 7M 60P
[*] Straight 5M 30P => 9M 70P
[*] Four_Of_A_Kind 7M 60P => 10M 90P
[*] Fortuna 12M 120P
[/olist]

New magic egg family (icons has been changed too!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004874/f3c8a4da1f6def4f805ad0df40569aab169e18b0.png[/img]

Because some "Magic Eggs" has been deleted, I added 6 prisms to replace them. Spoiler :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004874/3faa5ca24dffa2e0e13cb15ea2ff54cad16d6404.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004874/eb3884aa69710e120619b4f01a9ddbb449c6cfd6.gif[/img]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adding Prism Crystal
[*] Adding Prism Firetorch of Sapiens
[*] Adding Prism Velocity Shoes
[*] Adding Prism Nail
[*] Adding Prism Necklace
[*] Adding Prisme Hoof of Horok
[*] Adding Prism Dreamcatcher
[*] Adding Prism Bacteria.
[*] Wooden Grimace now react to extreme dice.
[*] Blobble can transfer its aura if the copied prism doesn't have an aura.
[*] Aura spawn rate different for each one (Mystical 35% / Azura 25% / Flame 25% / Inferno 15%)
[*] Deck "Doppelgänger" only add x2 Prism in inventory (no consummables x2 anymore)
[*] Level up cap to 1 Level up for 1 Attack for secondary figures (figures that are NOT your highest level)
[*] Linear progression of Point / Mult when figure level up
[*] Rework all hand figure
[*] Adding option to stop showing "Secret Figure Notification"
[*] Adding icons "Hijack" , "Aura", "Hijack"
[*] New value for figures Point and Mult
[*] New icons for "Magic Egg" prisms, with a color for each family
[/list]

[h1]Bug fix:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Four of Kind become a Flush if added a 5th die. Full House with all die same color possible only without relic "Flush in 4 Dice"
[*] Exp bar hover relics icons
[*] Less exp to level up to level 10
[*] Fix a bug, when "Amber Fruit" was at 0 incrementation just after last attack, it generate to +200P next fight.
[*] Fix list "Figure_Experience" not correctly populated before first call
[*] Conso "Change Color Red" have a new name "Hestia" (conflict with Hades).
[*] Fix unlock with new figures (temporary, achievement rework soon)
[*] Adding icon "Level Up". Prism tooltip for "Amber Fruit" and "Cape of Knowledge" refer to Level Up.
[*] Blobble now correctly copy highest prism.  
[*] Fixed experience calculation when there is lag on particule consommation
[*] Fix bug "Magic Egg" aura was skipped when it doesn't react to Attack figure
[*] Fixing amount of experience calculation
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 4
notes.notes:
[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Wine now reacts to the relic "+1 Potion Effect" (bonus is decremental).
[*]Milk now reacts to the relic "+1 Potion Effect".
[*]Prism "Arrow Bean" and "Frost Candles" are banned for the deck "Finite Fury".
[*]Added a debugger that triggers automatically after 12 seconds if you are stuck in a loop.
[*]Added an option to "Always show secret figure".
[*]Added icons for On/Off parameters in options and a wider right panel.
[*]Full keyboard support.
[*]New icons and tooltips for relics that allow prisms/relics/consumables to appear multiple times.
[*]Added information on buttons to indicate whether Attack or Reroll are Initial or Final.
[*]Faster base animation speed.
[*]Reduced waiting times after the level-up notification.
[*]New prism "Action Reaction" replaces "Sacrificial Gift".
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Deck "Finite Fury" regenerates when defeating a boss.
[*]Deck "Finite Fury" has a new tooltip and consistent attack and reroll numbers.
[*]Fixed relic count for the deck "Finite Fury".
[*]Debugged error when moving dice.
[*]Players can't use "Roll" after winning a game.
[*]Fixed bug where the potion "Reroll Shop" didn't erase a free reroll relic.
[*]Reroll shop costs are now correctly saved in player data.
[*]Prism bomb-storing damage capped at 2.3 billion.
[*]Fixed bug with the deck "Story Mode" in endless mode.
[*]Fixed prism "Amber Fruit" reacting to negative levels with the deck "Pointvers".
[*]Damage history now correctly shows monster health when you use the consumable "Wine" before any attack.
[*]Wine now shows the correct 20% damage tooltip.
[*]Multiplicative multipliers no longer exceed gold for the deck "Gold Limiter".
[*]Added Rune Omega 8 in the rest site.
[*]Prisms that react to different Pair/Three of a Kind/Four of a Kind now take the majority dice value.
[*]Fixed the deck "Inflation" bug; only purchased items add +1 gold.
[*]Added a tooltip for the bonus on the prism "Lower Case Upper Case".
[*]Fixed relic "Reroll Left Gives Gold".
[*]Deck "Doppelgänger" has a new tooltip.
[*]Fixed multiple bugs in prisms when using the consumable Milk (retrigger issues).
[*]Fixed wrong price "red effect" in the shop for the deck "Each Buy Increases Price".
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog v3 Early & Demo
notes.notes:
[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
Implemented true endless health for monsters, fixing endgame crashes.
Extrapolated experience level curve to prevent crashes.
Resolved infinite loop issue when looting epic prisms.
Fixed text display issues in tooltips.
Fixing issue for steam cloud for Demo

[u][b]Balancing:[/b][/u]
First boss have less health for difficulty 0 and 1
Rune "Athena": Now changes 1 face to Amethyst instead of 2.
Relic "One More Choice": Tooltip updated to "+1 additional choice after Battle Won."
Relic difficulty: Tooltip updated to "Enemy -10% Health, Enemy Elite -10% Health."
Added gameplay tips for relics with effects like "Extreme," "First," and "Initial."
Prism "Anvil": Tooltip updated for better explanation (e.g., attack contains 2 Threes).
Prism "Agonie": Changed rarity from common to rare.

[b][u]Gameplay Improvements:[/u][/b]
Localization added for relics.
Keyboard shortcut introduced to disable tutorials.
Collection now displays only unlocked prisms.
Added detailed luck tooltips.

[b][u]Art and Visuals:[/u][/b]
Prices now appear green when modified by relics or prisms.
Added missing keyboard input icons.

Thanks you for your feedback.
